summary: After the well in {place} runs dry, a resident finds out where the county wants the household shortage recorded.
realLife: The state asked counties to steer households with water shortages to its reporting site so residential well failures could be tracked.
gates: A household report or contact record identifies a shortage and the reporting channel.
inGame: needs: a household report or contact record identifies a shortage and the reporting channel.

turns.pulledBy: The intake shows a submitted household report.
turns.what: Give the resident the recorded report reference.
turns.writesBack: Keep the entry available for follow-up.

turns.pulledBy: The contact has no filed report.
turns.what: Pass on the county's reporting instructions.
turns.writesBack: Keep the contact distinct from a filed report.
